## Queen Cleopatrot (G4)

**Who she is:** An ancient Southern Equestrian pegasus queen inspired by Cleopatra, best remembered for her Egyptian-style gold cobra headdress, black straight-cut mane and tail, tan coat, yellow-green eyes, jewelry, wings, and sun cutie mark. Rarity encounters a magically animated historical exhibit featuring her in IDW's *Friendship Is Magic* #53 (May 3, 2017), in the *From the Shadows* arc.

**Names and identities:** **Queen Cleopatrot** is the name used in the IDW-comics/Gameloft material, not merely an invented fandom label. **Cleopatrot's Mummy** is an identifiable wrapped **game variant** of the queen. The pony dressed as Cleopatrot during the television episode **“Luna Eclipsed”** is **Sassaflash** (also called **Emerald Gem** in other media), *not* the historical queen herself. In *Legends of Magic* #11, Flash Magnus addresses **Somnambula** as “Cleopatrot”—apparently a dialogue mix-up, not proof they are the same character.

**Appearances and speech:** IDW *Friendship Is Magic* #53; a cameo in *Nightmare Knights* #1; the Gameloft *My Little Pony* mobile game (including **Nightmare Night at the Museum**, with Cleopatrot as a boss). No verified Queen Cleopatrot speaking role or voice actor in the animated series; do not attribute Sassaflash's voice to her. Her game description calls her a fashionable but fierce-tempered Southern Equestrian monarch. These are comic/game depictions; the show's Nightmare Night costume is not a separate appearance of the living queen.

**Images with artwork-page attribution:**

* **IDW panel:** Art by **Tony Fleecs**, colors credited to **Heather Breckel** in issue #53; Manebooru copy uploaded by **booruimporter**, originally posted on Derpibooru by **Masem**—neither uploader is the artist. [![Queen Cleopatrot in an IDW comic panel](https://static.manebooru.art/img/2020/8/18/1427540/full.png)](https://manebooru.art/images/1427540)
* **Character illustration:** Art and original DeviantArt post by **cheezedoodle96** (artist/uploader).
